title: Global action/keyboard shortcut for toggling sleep & screen locking inhibition
line: A new "Block or Unblock Sleep and Screen Locking" global shortcut toggles the Power and Battery applet's manual block from the keyboard.
explanation: The manual block of sleep and screen locking is held by the Power and Battery applet inside plasmashell, and the only way to toggle it was to open the applet and click its switch; there was no global action for it. The change registers a global action in the applet plugin's process-wide inhibition monitor (component plasmashell, like the notifications applet's Do Not Disturb toggle), unbound by default, which blocks or unblocks exactly like the switch and shows the same OSD.

commits.message:
applets/batterymonitor: add a global shortcut to block sleep and screen locking

Manually blocking sleep and screen locking was only possible by opening
the applet and clicking its switch. Add a global action, unbound by
default, that toggles the same block and shows the usual OSD feedback.

BUG: 513546

media.caption: Shortcuts > Plasma Workspace on master: no action for blocking sleep and screen locking.
With the fix: a new "Block or Unblock Sleep and Screen Locking" action, unbound by default.
Pressing the shortcut (bound to Ctrl+Alt+I for the test): the block is on, OSD shown, tray icon changes.

review.text: Clean, minimal implementation of the wishlist request in powerdevil's batterymonitor plugin, following the Notifications applet's Do Not Disturb pattern. Putting the unbound global action in the process-wide InhibitMonitor singleton keeps the plasmoid switch, tray icon, OSD, and inhibition cookies fully in sync across applet instances, and sets TRANSLATION_DOMAIN properly. Screenshots and verification notes clearly demonstrate the new shortcut and toggling behavior.
